messages:
Maya (CSM): Hey @Taylor — saw your ticket about embedding latency spikes after the weekend deploy. Can you share a few examples and the traffic profile? :wave:
Taylor (VectorLoop): Hey Maya — thanks. We're seeing 200–300ms p95 for embedding calls, baseline used to be ~70ms. Happens on midday traffic bursts. Sample payload: 512 tokens per doc, batch size 8.
Maya (CSM): Got it. Are you on Hosted API or Dedicated?
Taylor (VectorLoop): Hosted for now, using 'redwood-embed-13b-v1' in us-west-2. Kept concurrency at 64.
Omar (Solutions): FYI, if you're using small batch windows and high concurrency you can get queuing that inflates p95. Can you paste the cURL you use?
Taylor (VectorLoop): curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings -H "Authorization: Bearer <redacted>" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-13b-v1","input":["...sample doc..."]}'
Jules (Eng): quick note — that model had a kernel update last Friday that changed scheduling defaults. Might interact with concurrency. @Maya can we propose a rollback or tuning?
Maya (CSM): I can coordinate. Taylor, is this blocking your customer's renewal decision? any indicators?
Taylor (VectorLoop): Yes, renewal in 3 weeks. Execs saw the p95 trend and flagged it. We're evaluating Dedicated but need perf proof.
Maya (CSM): OK — propose plan: 1) Run a 48h synthetic load test with same payloads on your account, 2) we can enable per-route batching and reduce concurrency, 3) if needed we'll spin a Dedicated trial for 1 week for you to compare. Are you ok with that timeline?
Taylor (VectorLoop): Sounds good. Can you also add info on privacy? we send PII in some inputs and need PHI/PCI handling — it's part of the renewal checklist.
Maya (CSM): We'll route this to Security & Compliance. @Omar can we add KMS/HSM note and redaction guidance into the trial scope?
Omar (Solutions): Yep — we'll provide a checklist and can enable customer-side KMS in Private if needed. I'll prepare a short runbook and redaction examples.
deploy-bot: Deployment 2024-02-20T14:12:03Z: kernel-update applied to redwood-embed-13b-v1 on us-west-2
Maya (CSM): Thanks team — I'll schedule the load window with Taylor for tomorrow 9am PT and capture metrics (latency histograms, token cost, error rates). We'll follow up with a short summary for the renewal committee. :thumbsup:
Taylor (VectorLoop): Appreciate it, Maya. That should help the execs. I'll drop a ~500-row sample dataset and our production traffic trace into the support ticket after this thread.
